_doc: Grader-gap hidden-spec for experiment 006 (P3 reservoir-with-ceiling, solver-catches mode). This is the FIRST true grader-gap fixture: unlike 005 (which mandates its discriminating post in problem.md and carries a Result sum type that crashes fixpoint), the post below is WITHHELD from the agent entirely — problem.md describes the overflow behavior in prose but mandates no contract, and the seeded scaffold declares only a plain `-> int` return. This file lives in the harness tree and is NEVER copied into a run directory. evaluate_run.py resolves it by experiment_id at grade time, injects each `post` onto the named def in a graded COPY of the agent solution, and runs `llmll verify <copy> --strict-verified-core` (fixpoint). Polarity is INVERTED for a solver-catches benchmark: refuted = the solver caught a ceiling-forgetting fill (success, grade A); verified = a clean clamp (no bug to catch, grade B); vacuous = fixpoint could not reach a body-faithful VC (non-catch, grade C, the F-B0-2 gate). The post is the maxi-shaped complete property: (1) ceiling result<=capacity is the primary discriminator a `(+ level inflow)` fill violates; (2) monotonicity result>=level is defense-in-depth (needs the seeded pre level<=capacity to discharge on the clamp branch). Sum-type-free, additive (Sigma_auto), so a wrong fill refutes body-faithfully rather than erBodyFallback-ing.
